top_signals.title: Shipping Risks Repeating Stranded Asset Mistakes
top_signals.summary: Shipping lenders and investors risk repeating the mistakes made by Europe's electricity utilities and their financiers a decade ago, and the financial fallout could reach far beyond individual shipowners to lenders, investors, cargo owners and other supply-chain stakeholders…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
